adjudicator_input: exactly {sentence, candidate FOL, reference FOL, VERIFIED/UNVERIFIED tag}; no metric score, panel vote, solver label or repair op; no disguise; no reasoning trace requested

calibration.composition: 77 synthetic (z3-verified, VERIFIED ref) + 96 track-H pairs x 2 directions (H-orig: orig vs VERIFIED corr, gold UNFAITHFUL; H-corr: corr vs UNVERIFIED orig, gold FAITHFUL, expected reference_wrong=true); 21 curator-ambiguous pairs (42 items) reported separately, excluded from the gate

gate_rule.primary: point estimates on the GATE half, unambiguous items: balanced accuracy >= 0.85 AND recall_faithful >= 0.80 AND recall_unfaithful >= 0.80
gate_rule.robust_pass: secondary flag: full-set (dev+gate, unambiguous, chosen variant) Wilson 95% lower bound on EACH class recall >= 0.75
gate_rule.frozen: thresholds, items and prompt NEVER change after the gate half is scored

variant_selection_rule: run V1 and V2 on DEV half with the primary model; higher dev balanced accuracy wins; a tie within 0.01 goes to V1

census_predictions.definition: share of R_ADJ ERROR rows having >=1 op that contain >=1 op of the class

E_design.frame: heldout_candidates rows with system_class == 'llm' and final_label != UNPARSEABLE (UNPARSEABLE = ERROR by rule, never adjudicated, counted in the card)
E_design.panel_majority: >=2 agreeing votes among P1/P3/R1 in metadata_panel_votes
cells_first_match: D: trusted_ref & panel majority exists & solver_binary != panel_majority
U: final_label UNRESOLVED, or trusted_ref without a panel majority
B: tier B, solver and panel agreeing
L: stratum L25, tier A, agreeing
C: everything else (tier C / NO_TRUSTED_REFERENCE / DISPUTED_REFERENCE / unaudited refs); reference tagged UNVERIFIED
E_design.selection: sha1(item_id)-ordered within cell x stratum, n allocated proportional to stratum sizes (largest remainder); inclusion_prob = n_h/N_h per cell x stratum (x solver side for A)
E_design.tags: VERIFIED for trusted_ref rows; UNVERIFIED for cell C and UNAUDITED_* references
E_design.dedupe: same sentence + identical normalised candidate + same reference reuses the queried label (metadata_dedup_of); inclusion_prob unchanged
E_design.freeze: sampling_frame.json written and sha256 logged BEFORE the first E call
E_design.order: D -> A -> L -> B -> C -> U, concurrency 8; if the phase cap bites, the untouched remainder of the current cell is not_labelled and inclusion_prob = n_labelled/N_h

screen_design.S_dis: exp-A label in {CORRECT, ERROR} & screen final_label in {CORRECT, ERROR} & differ; inclusion 1
screen_design.D1: exp-D judge-vs-label disagreements with a reference, <=120 sha1(item_id)-first; inclusion 1
screen_design.control: 60 agreeing items (30 CORRECT / 30 ERROR) sha1-first; inclusion n/N per class
screen_design.reference: E2.reference_fol (D1 csv reference if the item is absent from E2), tag VERIFIED; NO_REFERENCE items skipped and counted
screen_design.reuse: track-H items identical (text, candidate, reference) to an H-orig calibration item reuse its verdict

fallback_ladder: primary fails and Grok passes on its gate half -> R_ADJ = Grok (rerun Steps 5-6 with Grok)
both fail -> no E regime; dual-label (primary + Grok) design cell D only as fold E_dual_ungated, label 'UNGATED'; card states 'R_ADJ dropped'

primary.rule: claude-sonnet-5: mean cost/call <= $0.0055 and JSON parse 10/10

grok_check.rule: cheapest x-ai model with pilot mean cost/call <= $0.004 at lowest reasoning effort

log.void_reason: key outage: the shared OpenRouter key hit its $50/day limit at 18:00:18 UTC mid-gate; 36/134 gate calls and 259/269 Grok calls returned HTTP 403 and were counted as parse failures. Not a gate result. Prompt, items and thresholds unchanged; the gate half is re-scored when the key resets.
